quiet-island-return.seed: I am coming home from college to the small island where I was raised. People have lived here for hundreds of years; everyone knows everyone, and the island has its own memory.
quiet-island-return.guidance: Build a grounded, open-ended daily-life situation. Start with only two or three immediately relevant people. Use routines, local work, weather, ferry schedules, family shops, old classmates and small social frictions. Do not force a plot, mystery, secret, romance, or escalating stakes. Humor comes from character behavior, mismatched assumptions and concrete inconvenience, never joke-writing. End scenes on a quiet image or unfinished small beat.
